name: cross-tenant-body
given: A request from tenant-a references tenant-b/route-a.
expected: 403 forbidden; no compile publication or upstream call

name: restricted-delegation
given: A resource-restricted admin tries granting tenant-wide admin to itself.
expected: 403 forbidden; authority revision unchanged

name: expired-delegation
given: Requested expiry exceeds the issuer credential/binding ceiling.
expected: 403 forbidden; no credential issued

name: revocation-cache-race
given: A new dispatch authorizes after the revoke applied acknowledgement.
expected: Deny dispatch; prior work may only finalize facts

name: activation-cas-race
given: Two commands expect the same active revision.
expected: One applied, one 409 revision_conflict

name: r1-r2-race
given: R1 is approved, R2 activates before an inference request with R1 arrives.
expected: Authorized retained R1 or pre-dispatch rejection, never R2 substitution

name: operation-payload-conflict
given: Same scoped operation ID is replayed with different state.
expected: 409 operation_conflict; never replay second mutation

name: late-commit-query
given: Management reply is lost after commit.
expected: Lookup returns the one durable applied result

name: suspended-audit
given: Work completes after suspension; audit worker reads retained receipt.
expected: Explicit audit grant reads; ordinary grants cannot dispatch or bypass lifecycle

name: duplicate-correlation
given: Two executions share correlation, second finishes after first query.
expected: 200 ExecutionPage; both recoverable through pagination/restarted scan, multiplicity is query-wide; no inference initiated

name: default-local-isolation
given: Authenticated hosted request omits tenant credentials.
expected: 401 unauthorized; never implicit local owner

name: unknown-owner
given: A migrated artifact has ambiguous ownership.
expected: Quarantine; no default-tenant fallback

name: wrong-backend-continuation
given: Client presents continuation from another backend/owner.
expected: Reject before provider work; receipt lookup cannot replay it

name: tenant-operator-not-installation-operator
given: A tenant_operator credential requests tenant lifecycle or principal changes.
expected: 403 forbidden; no installation authority inherited from a tenant role.

name: recipient-binding-reduction
given: An issued credential remains unexpired but its bound role/scope is reduced.
expected: Effective permissions are intersected with the current recipient binding at every attempt; no stale grant survives.

name: pool-grant-required
given: Tenant-wide permission references an operator_pool resource without an installation-operator pool grant.
expected: 403 forbidden before compilation/publication; tenant-wide does not include pools.

name: lost-issuance-recovery
given: Initial secret response was lost; same principal replays or looks up the operation.
expected: Replay has secret:null; lookup has credential ID/revision only. Read current revision, then CAS revoke or rotate without secret recovery.

name: credential-rotation-atomic
given: A rotation commits while the predecessor credential is used for a new attempt.
expected: Success atomically revokes predecessor and issues the same-principal replacement; acknowledgement follows authority publication.

name: concurrent-issuance-replay
given: Two authenticated requests concurrently submit the identical issuance command.
expected: Only the winning initial response may contain the secret; every replay/lookup omits it, including after restart.

name: operation-cross-kind-conflict
given: Same installation/principal/operation ID is reused for another method, target or operation kind.
expected: 409 operation_conflict; exactly one stored nonsecret result.

name: operator-operation-lookup
given: Installation operator loses a principal.put response.
expected: Original principal resolves it through the same installation-scoped lookup; another principal cannot read it.

name: capability-changed-before-dispatch
given: Controller cached eligible capabilities, then instance restarts or strict mode is disabled.
expected: Mismatched binding or disabled strict dispatch rejects before provider work; never silently downgrades or retries inference.

name: operation-capacity-latch
given: Ordinary operation IDs reach total minus safety reserve.
expected: Persistently latch off all new inference, attempts/wakes and ordinary mutations; installation operator may spend reserved IDs only on revoke or inactive lifecycle transitions.

name: safety-reserve-exhausted
given: Safety operation reserve is exhausted or authority storage fails.
expected: Inference stays fenced; no ID eviction/reuse. Read/finalization/host stop remain available when storage permits; use offline recovery.

name: retired-installation-replay
given: An old command or credential is sent to the fresh installation after fenced offline recovery.
expected: Reject old installation binding and credentials before any mutation or provider call; retained old facts remain separate.

name: shared-credential-store-cutover
given: Two state directories select the same credential file while a refresh replacement is pending.
expected: Fence every selected-path writer, settle or quarantine pending refresh and assign pool/slot ownership before activation.

name: restricted-scope-cannot-empty-active-snapshot
given: A route-a-only credential knows the current activation CAS revision and submits empty routes/null policy.
expected: 403 forbidden; tenant-wide policy.activate is required in both credential and current binding, no active snapshot change.

name: restricted-scope-cannot-change-tenant-limits
given: A resource-scoped operator attempts to activate zero concurrency or changed learning settings while keeping its permitted route.
expected: 403 forbidden; resource coverage and CAS never confer tenant-wide activation authority.

name: tenant-wide-activation-explicit-pool-intersection
given: Tenant-wide credential includes pool-a but the current binding omits it (or vice versa).
expected: 403 forbidden; both scopes need the exact pool key and a live installation-operator-managed binding.

name: operation-read-same-principal-other-tenant
given: Principal P uses a valid tenant-b credential to query its earlier tenant-a operation.
expected: Generic forbidden/not-found; no result, revision, target IDs or existence metadata from the tenant-a operation.

name: operation-read-narrowed-resource-scope
given: Principal P retains resource.read but no longer covers a saved affected resource of an earlier command.
expected: Generic forbidden/not-found; original principal equality and knowledge of operation ID do not authorize history access.

name: operation-read-installation-downgrade
given: The original installation operator principal later presents only a tenant credential.
expected: Generic forbidden/not-found; installation-class results require current installation authority.

name: operation-read-after-valid-rotation
given: The original credential rotates; the same principal still has the saved tenant, affected scope and required result-read permission.
expected: Return the retained nonsecret result; do not require the old credential secret or reapply the mutation.

name: operation-replay-current-read-authority
given: A committed command is identically replayed after the same principal loses access to an affected resource.
expected: Generic forbidden/not-found before result or conflict disclosure; never reapply the committed command or regain read access.

name: receipt-provenance-no-upgrade
given: One attempt carries estimated or incomplete usage while the aggregate numeric sum is known.
expected: Preserve conservative estimated/unknown provenance and complete:false; no provider/complete upgrade from numeric equality.
